titles: Why Is Switzerland So Rich? (No Sea, No Oil, Mostly Mountains)
Switzerland Had Nothing. Now It's One of the Richest Countries on Earth
How Switzerland Got Rich Selling Things That Weigh Almost Nothing
hook: Switzerland has no sea, almost no oil, gas or coal, and mountains almost everywhere. In 1817 some Swiss people ate grass to survive. Today it produces about $107,700 per person a year (World Bank, 2024), about eight times the world average. How? Watches, tunnels through the Alps, neutrality, banks, medicine from Basel and apprenticeships, explained with maps, charts and real numbers. No background needed.
